name: dev.tokensafe/tokensafe
title: TokenSafe
description: Your AI agent is smart enough to code all day. Local firewall & zero-loss runtime.

tools.name: get_public_stats
tools.description: Returns aggregated public TokenSafe stats (total tokens saved, active teams). No auth.

tools.name: check_latest_version
tools.description: Checks the client version against the latest published tokensafe release.

tools.name: get_license_status
tools.description: Validates the Bearer license key and returns tier, expiry and trial state.

tools.name: get_team_metrics
tools.description: Returns the authenticated account's dashboard data: savings, telemetry stats, licenses and team seats.

tools.name: distill_prompt
tools.description: Managed Cloud Distillation: compiles a verbose developer prompt into a dense TOCP S-expression server-side. Requires Solo/Team license.

context_hint.description: Optional: short context hint for the distiller

tools.name: team_cache_lookup
tools.description: Looks up a shared team distillation cache entry by hash. Requires Team license.

tools.name: team_cache_store
tools.description: Stores a distilled result in the shared team cache so teammates reuse it. Requires Team license.

tokens_saved.description: Approximate tokens saved by this entry

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Lists Stripe billing invoices for the authenticated account.

tools.name: get_setup_instructions
tools.description: Returns exact MCP configuration snippets for a coding agent (cursor, claude_desktop, claude_code, codex, windsurf, antigravity, gemini_cli).

agent.description: Agent name; omit to list supported agents

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Searches the built-in TokenSafe knowledge base (features, install, tiers, privacy).

tools.name: generate_team_seat
tools.description: Team owner: provisions a seat license for a member email.

tools.name: revoke_team_seat
tools.description: Team owner: revokes a previously issued seat license.

tools.name: preview_weekly_digest
tools.description: Team owner: previews the weekly team stats digest (same data as the Friday email).
